propositions: det_floor.py exceeds 800-line hard cap at 793 LOC and requires splitting along the blocking/never-blocking check boundary to reduce headroom pressure.

The four never-blocking checks (p2_resolution, p3_package_existence, p6_ac_quality, p7_destructive) form a closed call-graph cluster with zero edges to the retained blocking checks (p1, p4, p5, p8, p10, p11), enabling clean extraction without severing dependencies.

Moving p6_ac_quality requires binding its bare-name dependencies (vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, _verify_command_strings) at module level in det_advisory.py rather than inheriting them from det_floor.py's import block.

det_floor.py must stay the entry module, re-export all moved checks, and retain symbols monkeypatched by test suites (DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens, _clarity_score, _count_ac_items, _description_limit) to preserve test binding semantics.

After the split, det_floor.py must measure ≤720 LOC with ≥29% headroom, det_advisory.py ≥100 LOC, and both must fall within the 200–500 target band without triggering complexity-baseline or module-size-limit ratchets.
